answer: A delta-ladder bond charges more per identity. An agent bonds a rung of the tundra ladder: rung one costs 40, rung k costs 40+6(k-1), each marked by a pigment band auditors check. Bonds sit in an ocean escrow, released on verification; a forged band burns the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,037,000 credits for a 40,000 pool. Rented rungs are the failure mode: borrowing one burns both bonds; an honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its share.
